messages:
Rory Kim: I'm starting a tiny refresh on the WelcomeKit quickstart to standardize auth, swap fetch snippets for SDK calls, and add a one-paragraph Docker deploy path. Posting draft in a bit.
Ana Patel: Thanks. Please normalize env var to REDWOOD_API_KEY (we still have REDWOOD_KEY floating around).
Rory Kim: Yep. Will also update all curl examples to use Authorization: Bearer <token> and remove mentions of X-API-KEY.
Jon (devex): Could you include a 1-line streaming example for Node and Python? Customers ask for that in onboarding.
Rory Kim: Adding compact streaming samples and a one-sentence when-to-use note: streaming for incremental UIs, non-streaming for simple short replies.
Ruth (QA): Add a short troubleshoot section for the common 401s in docker: missing var, extra quotes, and Linux permissions on .env.
Rory Kim: Done. Also added HEALTHCHECK in Dockerfile and a sample CMD.
BuildBot: link-check: docs/quickstart/welcomekit.md -> /api/usage/old is 404. Suggest /api/usage/overview.
Rory Kim: Fixed link and pushed branch: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/643>.
Ana Patel: One nit: remove the paragraph about token scopes for hosted API 1; that's only for private installs.
Rory Kim: Removed and added a note linking to the Private deployment docs.
Ruth (QA): Ran sample runner: node samples/welcome.js failed due to old header X-API-KEY. After update samples pass locally.
Jon (devex): LGTM. Suggest trimming examples to under 10 lines each for quickstart brevity.
Rory Kim: Trimmed both examples and marked PR ready. Will merge after CI.
BuildBot: CI: md-lint OK; link-check OK; sample smoke tests OK.
Rory Kim: Merging in ~5 min. I'll ping #all-hands after site deploy.
